name: application-endpoint-method-row
title: Endpoint Method Row
description: API-reference list of HTTP method pill, path, and description rows — distinct from webhook-event-row, which shows delivered webhook event history (timestamps, status, payload) rather than a reference of available endpoints.
useWhen: Documenting a list of available API endpoints with their HTTP methods.
You want each method (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) to be instantly scannable via a distinct color.
Paths should render in a monospace font distinct from the description text.
avoidWhen: You need a history of actual webhook deliveries with status and timestamps — use webhook-event-row instead.
You need an interactive request builder — use request-builder instead.
There's only a single endpoint to document — inline code is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are full-width within their container; the description column truncates with ellipsis if the row runs out of horizontal space.
accessibility: The HTTP method pill uses both a distinct background/text color per method and readable text, never color alone.
Path segments are rendered as monospace <code> to visually distinguish them from prose.
List semantics (ul/li) allow assistive tech to announce the number of endpoints.

variants.title: Endpoint method row
variants.description: A five-endpoint REST reference (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /v1/users) with color-coded method pills, on a light surface.
accessibility: Each method pill's color is distinct across all five HTTP methods for quick visual scanning.

variants.title: Endpoint method row (Dark)
variants.description: The same five-endpoint reference, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Method pill background/text pairs meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
